profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer - Infrastructure
profile.summary:
It has been my experience that surrounding yourself with self-motivated professionals with differing backgrounds produces the best software. Developing software and systems and anticipating user experience can be the most important and difficult aspect of software design, but also the most interesting. I strive to stay informed of new technologies and methodologies.

Specialties: Full software development life cycle (ideation, architecture, design, develop, ci/cd, test, and devops), interacting with clients to gather requirements, team development, Java, Server Side / Backend, API Design, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, Azure, Federated Authentication, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer - Infrastructure
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Skills: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Infrastructure · Software Engineering · Software Design · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer and Principal Investigator
positions.description:
Member of the architecture team responsible for guiding the development of LLNL enterprise level applications as well as providing identity solutions to the Department of Energy:
Designed and developed a federated authentication and identity management system for the Department of Energy. The system is developed in Java and is tiered (web, app, database) and SOA based (via Jersey RESTful web services). Authentication is federated using the SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect specifications leveraging PingFederate and MySQL database cluster.
DevOps engineer with experience deploying to Kubernetes (on-premise, EKS, and AKS).
Lead engineer for the Java PingFederate plugin to provide SCIM provisioning to the identity management system.
Principal Investigator for a team building a completely serverless, extensible data architecture (ETL) ingesting multiple data sources, aligning common fields in a metastore, and curating data to use-case specific  consumers. Leading architecture and development of the system.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Primary contributor providing a physical access security system for Department of Energy facilities: Designed and developed a suite of intelligent driver libraries for several hardware devices in the access control system using the C# programming language. Three libraries service serial devices and one services a TCP device. Lead designer for the serial communication protocol between proprietary hardware in the access control system to support enhanced security, specifically smart card chip technology. Researched and developed a solution for communicating between a C++ graphical user interface application and a C# dynamic link library using windows named pipes. Site representative to Department of Energy working groups; contributing to requirements and regulations for access control systems. Contributor of technical information regarding NIST specifications regarding the PIV smartcard application and interaction. Designing and planning for the next generation of the current physical access security system; including overall architecture and adherence to regulations and requirements. Divisional representative on the steering committee for the company's Software Improvement Networking Group. The group invites experts, both internally and externally, on topics related to improving the software development lifecycle.
